div.head: Commentary on α 123
div.p: The comparison with Phryn. PS 82.5–6 may suggest that the two entries belonged in a larger, onomastic section about words deriving from κίβδηλος. Indeed, the lemma of Phryn. PS 82.5–6 is clearly reminiscent of Ar. Ra. 720–1, where the coin metaphor is a reference to Athenian politicians (cf. Dover 1993, 281–2). Therefore, the two entries going back to the PS have more in common than it may look at first sight.
